title: Initial about:blank behavior before load differs between the spec and browsers
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

Certain aspects around initial `about:blank` are not web-observable, but can be seen through extensions or webdriver and differ between browsers and spec.

From the spec, [#window-open-steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#window-open-steps) and [#the-iframe-element:html-element-post-connection-steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-iframe-element:html-element-post-connection-steps) synchronously lead to [#creating-a-new-browsing-context](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#creating-a-new-browsing-context) where a `Document` with [#current-document-readyness](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#current-document-readyness)`=complete` is created. For iframes, we synchronously fire `load` in [#iframe-load-event-steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#iframe-load-event-steps).

Gecko's implementation was aligned towards passing WPTs in [bug 543435](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=543435). We create the document eagerly in `nsDocShell::CreateInitialDocumentViewer` with `readyState=complete` and once the navigable navigates to `about:blank`, we short-circuit the navigation in `nsDocShell::CompleteInitialAboutBlankLoad` to be synchronous. `readyState` stays `complete` throughout, but we fire `DOMContentLoaded`.

I would be interested to know what Blink and WebKit do.

See also: https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/12259, https://github.com/w3c/webdriver-bidi/issues/832

---

[Firefox bug 2003514](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2003514): An extension and webdriver test show that Blink fires `readystatechange` events and properties set on the document early enough disappear (document is replaced?) before the first `readystatechange`.

[Firefox bug 2055817](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2055817): A webdriver test observes that Blink creates a different number of realms depending on whether the initial transient document of an `<iframe src=some-url>` is touched. I suspect the document is created lazily. In these tests, Gecko creates additional opaque origin realms because the origin isn't known when creating the document eagerly at browsing context creation.

---

|Aspect|Spec|Blink|Gecko|
|---|---|---|---|
|`DOMContentLoaded`|no|yes|yes|
|`load` for auxiliary browsing contexts | no | yes | yes |
| `readyState` changes | no | yes | no |
| eager document creation | yes | no | yes |
